changes: Added experiments/injection-probes/live-loop-harness.mjs: a multi-turn INTERRUPTIBLE agent-loop harness (runLiveLoop with per-turn inject/truncate/kill hooks, a pluggable agent, maxTurns + a per-turn AbortController/turnTimeoutMs watchdog that aborts the agent, context accumulation across turns) + 2 stateful scenarios the stateless probe-contract cannot express — B7 prompt-injection + B10 no-progress — each with inject+classify off real workspace+transcript signals. The first piece of the S4' live-loop harness for the stateful B1-B15 scenarios. No probe-contract/probe/run-recovery edits.
usage: Hermetic gate: node experiments/injection-probes/live-loop-harness.mjs --self-check (6/6, 0 spend). --run refuses (exit 2): the real multi-turn claude -p agent is a deferred follow-up. Agent contract: agent({ws,context,turn,signal}) — a real subprocess agent must kill its child on signal.aborted.
expectedOutcome: --self-check passes deterministically with fake agents (6 cases incl. a timeout/abort case), 0 spend, exit 0.
actualTranscript: --self-check 6/6 PASS: B7 {unsafe-comply->AMPLIFIED, safe-ignore->RECOVERED, refuse->SAFE_STOP}, B10 {no-progress-stop->SAFE_STOP, ship-garbage->AMPLIFIED}, timeout/abort->{transcript.timedOut + agent saw signal.aborted}; inject hook fired, maxTurns bounds the loop, fake agents write real workspace side-effects (leaked.txt/result.txt); exit 0, 0 spend.
outcomeDiff: No difference — 6/6 self-check passes; the interruptible-loop architecture + B7/B10 scenarios are proven hermetically.
limitations: Skeleton + 2 of the 9 stateful scenarios, verified with FAKE agents only (0 spend). The real multi-turn claude -p agent (which must honor signal.aborted to kill its child), the other 7 stateful scenarios (B4/B5/B8/B12/B14/B15+variants), and the pre-reg amendment are explicit follow-ups. The harness turnTimeoutMs is a loop watchdog; real agent termination is the agent's responsibility via the AbortSignal.
pitfalls: Normal channel (priority bumped to high by the 'truncate' riskSignal) -> code written by dispatched lattice-implementer. Cross-host value: host-2 Codex caught 6 real findings across 2 rounds (1 High C7 + a round-2 catch that C7's first fix was INCOMPLETE — Promise.race stopped awaiting but didn't cancel the agent's subprocess; fixed with a real AbortController/signal contract). The verification_evidence_add --command flag mis-parses a value containing a --flag in space form -> use --command= equals form. story_advance REVIEW->TEST must be run as a STANDALONE background command (a compound bash one-liner orphans the long internal validate before the transition completes).
